Health & Safety Safety Alert No. 01/ FY24-25

Godadih Limestone Mines, Chilhati Jindal Steel & Power, Raigarh
Incident Category: Near Miss Case
Date of Incident: 16.10.2024 Time: 07:45 PM

Location: Mines Gate

What Happened?

A tipper was engaged in transporting ROM from the mines to the crusher. After unloading the material
at the crusher hopper, the tipper proceeded to take its next load towards the mines. At 7:45 PM, while
the tipper's dump body was in a raised position, it collided with the lifting barrier bar at the Mines Gate.
No injuries were sustained, and there was no significant damage to any property

Initial Finding:

1. When the tipper CGO7 CC 8760 was going for taking load the mechanic was also sitting beside the operator.
2. At the time of collision, the dump body was lifted in full position.
3. There was no system for alerting the operator for raised position of dump body.
